description: This file defines the interface for timestamp utilities, including functions for retrieving, comparing, manipulating, and computing durations for timestamps represented as 'timespec' structures. It provides an API for handling high-resolution timestamps in a cross-platform manner.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp and stores it in the provided timespec structure.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_cmp
methods.description: Compares two timestamps and returns an integer indicating their order.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_subtract_ns
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps in nanoseconds.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_subtract_us
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps in microseconds.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_subtract_ms
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps in milliseconds.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_add_ns
methods.description: Adds a specified number of nanoseconds to a timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_add_us
methods.description: Adds a specified number of microseconds to a timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_add_ms
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to a timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_add_secs
methods.description: Adds a specified number of seconds to a timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_ns
methods.description: Returns the number of nanoseconds until a specified timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_us
methods.description: Returns the number of microseconds until a specified timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_ms
methods.description: Returns the number of milliseconds until a specified timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_ns
methods.description: Returns the number of nanoseconds since a specified timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_us
methods.description: Returns the number of microseconds since a specified timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_ms
methods.description: Returns the number of milliseconds since a specified timestamp.
